defiscan.summary: Liquity V1 is an immutable, governance-free borrowing protocol on Ethereum that issues LUSD stablecoins against ETH collateral at a minimum 110% collateralization ratio. All smart contracts are non-upgradeable with ownership renounced to the zero address, making the protocol fully autonomous. The system relies on Chainlink and Tellor as dual oracle sources for ETH/USD pricing, with an automatic fallback mechanism between the two. The protocol holds $0 in total value across its contracts.
